faqs.question: What exactly is an AI receptionist?
faqs.answer: It's an AI employee that answers your business phone line, handles common questions, books appointments into your calendar, and logs leads so calls can be handled even when your team is busy or after hours.

faqs.question: How much does it cost?
faqs.answer: There is a one-time setup fee, typically $300 to $1,000 depending on the complexity of the setup, plus a monthly subscription that covers hosting, voice minutes, and support. Exact pricing depends on the business and its requirements.

faqs.question: How can I get an exact quote?
faqs.answer: For an exact quote, submit your business details through the business details form at https://aixsystems.vercel.app/demo. You can also provide your email so the team can follow up personally.

faqs.question: How long does setup take?
faqs.answer: Most businesses are live within a week once AI X Systems receives the necessary business details, including services, hours, and FAQs.

faqs.question: Does it replace my staff?
faqs.answer: No. The AI handles repetitive front-desk work such as answering common questions and booking appointments, allowing your team to focus on customers who need human attention.

faqs.question: Can it work with my existing calendar and CRM?
faqs.answer: Yes. The system can connect to Google Calendar for appointment booking and can log leads to a spreadsheet or CRM depending on the setup.

faqs.question: Can the AI answer calls after business hours?
faqs.answer: Yes. The AI Receptionist can handle calls 24/7, including nights, weekends, and holidays.

faqs.question: Can the AI transfer calls to a real person?
faqs.answer: Yes. Call-transfer rules can be configured for situations such as urgent requests, specific customer types, or questions that require a human.

faqs.question: What happens if the AI cannot answer a question?
faqs.answer: Depending on the configured rules, the AI can take a message or transfer the call to a person. The team can then receive the relevant lead or call information.

faqs.question: Do you offer phone or video discovery calls?
faqs.answer: No. AI X Systems no longer offers phone or video discovery calls. Customers who want to move forward can provide their email for a personal follow-up or submit their business details through the business details form.

faqs.question: Can I try the AI before getting one for my business?
faqs.answer: Yes. There is a live AI receptionist demo available on the AI X Systems website that lets you experience how the receptionist works. The live demo is separate from the business details form.
